summary: UGI Corporation filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary UGI Utilities entered into a note purchase agreement for a $125 million private placement of 5.45% Senior Notes due 2031. The notes are unsecured, rank pari passu with existing debt, and proceeds will refinance indebtedness and for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation, and contains standard covenants and events of default.
